verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE agent investigates incidents in Slack and can answer natural-language queries for logs/charts, and it auto-generates a post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack conversation — reducing some manual writing. However, the story specifically wants live, in-the-moment summaries and call-note scribing while the incident is unfolding, and the evidence only shows post-incident post-mortem generation and investigative Q&A, not real-time drafted status updates or call transcription. Missing for 10: evidence of live/real-time incident summary drafting during an active call, evidence of call-note scribing (voice/transcript capture), and evidence of automatically drafted customer-facing updates as the incident progresses.
